'''Negal Tek'lon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Negal Tek'lon appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
